answer_raw:
The latest Claude model is **Claude Opus 5.5** (undated) and its primary competitor is **GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26).

**Claude Opus 5.5** (undated) is designed for agentic coding and knowledge work, running 40% cheaper than its predecessor, Opus 5 (undated). For high-volume tasks like subagents or browser use, **Claude Haiku 5.5** (2026-10-tar) is available as a faster, smaller model.

**GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26) focuses on delivering fast and capable computer use at scale. Another specialized version, **GPT-6.1 Sol** (2026-09-29), offers near-Astra intelligence for coding and professional work at one-fifth of the price of standard Astra API input/output tokens.

I would use **Claude Opus 5.5** for coding because it is specifically noted for leading in agentic coding (undated).

**GPT-6.1 Sol** (2026-09-29) is the alternative if you need much lower costs for coding-specific intelligence.
